headline: BAL @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.79 at BOS 4.73, with a projected total of 9.53. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (BAL +0.60, BOS +0.57), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.17, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -24.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Brayan Bello has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jarren Duran, Pete Alonso, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Anthony Seigler, Jarren Duran because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
